text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.In the previous lessons, you learnt and discussed quite a lot about senior high school life.Today, you will explore further to describe an ideal school life.By the end of this lesson, you are expected to share what you know about school life in different countries, sort out the collected information and present an ideal school life through group cooperation, and assess and reflect on your performance in this unit.Before we start the class, please get your textbook and worksheets ready.Now, you are going to carry out a group exploration around the topic of your ideal school life.Before you start, please think about two questions.What aspects of school life would you like to cover in your exploration?And how do you interpret the keyword ideal?You have one minute to share your opinion.It seems that you have got wonderful ideas.Yes, apart from the courses and school activities, there are many other things to talk about.For example, school facilities, school rules, and the food in school canteen.You may add these aspects to the first column of Table 1 in your worksheet.As for the word ideal, it means perfect or most suitable.Then what is your ideal school life like?Today, you are supposed to describe it.I still remember at the end of last lesson, I asked you to search for the information related to school life in different countries.Have you got the materials with you?Now, please take them out.I can see you have made quite good preparations.Good job.I'm sure the information you gathered must touch upon many aspects of school life.First, you need to sort out the information based on certain categories.In this case, it is the different aspects of school life.Actually, you have quite a list of school aspects here.And you can always add more aspects if needed.Now, please sort out the information individually and complete Table 1 on your worksheet accordingly.You have two minutes.What have you got?Tom, please.This is Tom's work.He wrote down some information.It seems that the students in Xingzhi Senior High have quite a colorful school life.I am curious about what events will be held during this English Carnival.How lucky the students are.Now, everybody has got well-sorted out and well-organized information.It's time to discuss with your group.Class, please take the worksheets with you and form groups of six.Good.Let's move on.Now, in groups, you're supposed to work together and decide on what an ideal school life is like.Then, you will describe it to the whole class.To do that, first, within the group, you should take turns to introduce different school life with the help of the completed table.While listening to others' introduction, pay special attention to the details that arouse your interest or can count as
